environment: Headless Chromium on macOS. 320/768/1024/1360 viewport and tablet touch emulation; no claim of physical-device or Safari/Firefox coverage.

internalReferences.scope: Static generated HTML: all relative file and fragment references in anchors, stylesheets, scripts and images. External links and dynamic query contents are excluded. Public page rendering is checked separately.

publicRemasters.scope: Reading-page play clicks with normal scrolling; timed SVG scene geometry, pause/resume, seek from end and replay. Authored waits and equilibrium/boundary defaults are explicit, with a separate nonzero-input motion test. Static models are counted separately. This is playback QA, not all original-runtime input equivalence.

repair.problem: A force arrow from another mass could intercept pointerdown on a chain mass.
repair.fix: Force lines ignore pointer events. Physics, geometry, timelines and CSV unchanged.
